Runner bug (B27h): three tests assert the process's own error-event and uncaughtException handling (an unheard window error becomes an uncaught exception), which the worker's own process handlers change, so each fails under Provino and passes on node:test.
files.packages/lazy/src/api.test.ts: Four tests assume no lazy runtime is installed and that the slot is the process's own; under Provino the worker owns that process-global slot, so they cannot run inside it (B27g1).
files.packages/lazy/src/read.test.ts: The unhandled-rejection test owns the process-wide rejection handler the runner's worker already holds (B27g1).
files.packages/provino/test/bootstrap/canary.t: The canary: it runs the built runner on a fixture with known failures and asserts they are reported, so a runner that reports green wrongly is caught (D203). It must not depend on the runner it checks.
files.packages/transform/src/pipeline.test.ts: Runner bug (B27h): the worker installs its own Error.prepareStackTrace, so process.setSourceMapsEnabled(true) no longer maps a stack to the original .ts line, and two tests expecting `boom.ts:6:9` get the generated .mjs position.
